description: This file defines the DebugProfiler class, which is responsible for profiling and debugging within the Goteo project. It manages kernel events, SQL query stats, session and cookie data, and renders profiling views.

classes.name: DebugProfiler
classes.description: A class for profiling and debugging, capturing kernel events, SQL queries, session, cookies, and rendering debug views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the profiler, sets up view folder, stopwatch, and start time.

methods.name: addKernelEvent
methods.description: Adds a kernel event to the profiler, capturing controller, request, and response info.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the profiling view with collected data, including SQL stats, events, session, cookies, headers, and errors.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern to get the current instance of DebugProfiler.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Static method to add a kernel event to the profiler.

methods.name: getHeadContent
methods.description: Returns the rendered header content for the profiler.

methods.name: getBodyContent
methods.description: Returns the rendered body content for the profiler.
